items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: Johnny Hodges and Sonny came with me... I went backstage... Johnny Hodges, Johnny Hodges, Johnny, Johnny Hodges and Sonny came with me

ctx.x: Johnny Hodges, Johnny Hodges, Johnny, Johnny Hodges and Sonny came with me, and what, so, Sonny always had an affectionate way of walking with you, put his arm around you and he's walking like this and always, even in New York, he used to take me up to Harlem and what, I knew more about Harlem than I knew about Bourbon Street because Sonny used to take me up there and O'Neal Spenter used to take me up there and he used to go up there to get ribs and it was like walking in, in your own living room, you know, you…
Duke, Duke, look who's here, look, Son Godfrey's here, Godfrey's here.
